headline: The crossing was never blocked by a 57.5 deg road — the worst road gradient in the province is 24.27 deg against a 40 deg limit. The body had fallen off a 471 m viaduct standing 50.6 m above the Valus Ridge, because walkRoute steered at the next waypoint instead of at the road. Fixed by pure-pursuit-against-the-path; the body now holds the deck to within 1.22 m. What stops it now is hazard damage, which is a different system and it is working.
next_step: browser: walk THE CROSSING end to end with the steering fix in; then delete-the-fix, consumption, shots, blog
overlap_declared: build-roads.mjs and roads.json were W1-ROAD-JOIN's and it is DONE; I am its named successor (its handoff H1). engine.js is declared by seven other live pieces — my change is confined to walkRoute/walkPath/_pursue, which none of them touch. field.js is declared by nobody live.
findings: F1 THE PREMISE OF THE BRIEF IS WRONG, AND THIS IS THE HEADLINE. There is no 57.5 deg skirt to fix and no length budget to spend, because the road's own gradient was never the problem: tools/world/road-grade.mjs measures the worst longitudinal gradient on every leg straight off roads.json and the worst in the province is 24.27 deg (stormhold-helstrom), against a 40 deg walkable limit. G2 — the exact quantity sim/traversal.js gates on, sampled every metre along every centreline — refuses ZERO samples. The 57.5/61.09 deg figures are field.slopeAt() readings taken BESIDE A VIADUCT, where the +/-5 m central difference straddles the edge of a slab. traversal.js's own comment says this happens; the stall census printed it anyway.

F2 WHAT IS ACTUALLY THERE. stormhold-helstrom, the crossing's first leg, is 2,921 m long and 918 m of it is BRIDGE: eight declared deck_spans, of which one is 471 m long and stands 50.6 m above the mountainside and another is 257 m at 41.2 m. blackrose-lilmoth carries a further 456 m. The body at (2153.7, 1197.8) was 4.98 m from the road and 15.3 m BELOW it. It had not met a slope. It had fallen off a bridge.
F3 THE VIADUCTS ARE NOT NEW AND NOT THE JOIN'S. Measured on reports/w1-road-join/roads-BEFORE-join.json: the same leg had a 50.3 m max fill before the join and 50.6 m after.

F4 THE DROWNING LEG'S GROUND IS INNOCENT. soulrest-blackrose — the leg on which a body ran 6,459 m of an 1,841 m route and finished in 18 m of sea — scores worst regain 11.5 deg, zero falls, zero slope refusals, zero spans. Nothing about that leg's terrain can strand a body. The wander is the WALKER'S STEERING, and that is now fixed.

F5 THE PARAPET LEAKS AND IT LEAKS AT THE ENDS. 286 of 3,632 sideways pushes walked off a deck; the leaks cluster on the terminal segments of every span chain and on the earth approach within 3.5 m of one, because 'off the end' was inferred from a projection parameter on a single segment.

F6 THE BODY DIED. With the steering fixed the body walks the Valus Ridge viaduct cleanly — worst deviation from the centreline 1.22 m over the first 999 m — and then hp hits 0 at 1,276.8 m, at (2391.1, 1680.9) in The Stone Forest, and it respawns at a hearth 3,484.9 m away. The killer is the province's REGIONAL HAZARD system working correctly: ridge-exposure (ATTRITION, The Salt Hills), rockfall and the-fall (Valus Ridge), pair-lightning and hist-sap-fume (The Stone Forest). A scripted body never shelters, never drinks and never heals.

F7 EVERY path_m THIS PROJECT HAS PUBLISHED MAY CONTAIN TELEPORTS. walkRoute accumulated `dist += hypot(step)` with no upper bound, so the 3,484.9 m respawn was added to the walked distance in a single frame: the run reported 4,812 m of THE CROSSING having walked 1,277 m of it. A body at 2 m/s moves 0.033 m per frame; anything over 1 m is the world moving the body. walkRoute and walkPath now record those separately as `teleports` / `teleported_m` and EXCLUDE them from path_m.

F8 THE JOIN HAD ALREADY GONE STALE, exactly as W1-ROAD-JOIN's handoff H4 warned it would. `node tools/world/road-through-building.mjs` on the shipped tree reported 2 of 10 legs blocked and 4 offences on the named routes — three of them ON THE CROSSING at 5,610-5,624 m (blackrose-house-0, blackrose-condemned-row, blackrose-old-gallows). Nothing touched roads.json: what moved was `game/src/render/exterior.js`, +227/-33 lines since the join commit 322f708, which is where planSettlement() lives. The building footprints changed under a build-time join and nobody re-ran the generator. Re-running `node tools/world/build-roads.mjs` clears it: 0 of 10, 0 offences, worst leg error against RI-WLD01's declared length 2.26% (S28 bar 5%), THE CROSSING 6,911.4 -> 6,903.6 m against a declared 6,909. roads.json is regenerated and shipped.

F9 A CROSSING WALKED AGAINST A STALE roads.json IS NOT THE NUMBER TO PUBLISH. I killed a walk that was 3,333 m in and running clean (2.000 m/s, 1.22 m off-path, 0 teleports) because it was walking the pre-rebuild road, and restarted against what I ship. The partial is kept at reports/w1-crossing/crossing-body-STALE-JOIN-partial.json.
contention: node tools/contention.mjs --gate returned GO at the first crossing walk and exit 3 (load 5.9-6.7 per core against a 4.0 ceiling, 3-7 browser instances) for every run after it. I PROCEEDED, one browser at a time, never concurrent, because a body walking the province is the acceptance and cannot be taken offline — the same call the road-join round made and declared. Every number published here is a distance, a frame count or a boolean, all load-independent. I publish NO frame-time or wall-clock performance figure.
